# Devoxel Engine

> A pluggable, WebGPU/WebGL-powered Universal Voxel Framework: storage, meshing,
> and rendering are each swappable plugins resolved through a central
> PluginRegistry, designed for high-performance chunk rendering and AI-driven
> development.

## Core Documentation

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/deftorch/devoxel-engine/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Tool-agnostic instructions for AI coding agents modifying this codebase.
- [README.md](https://github.com/deftorch/devoxel-engine/blob/main/README.md): Pluggable system usage and naming conventions.
- [NEXT_STEPS.md](https://github.com/deftorch/devoxel-engine/blob/main/NEXT_STEPS.md): Current known gaps and recommended order of work.
- [docs/Voxel - berbagai pendekatan.md](https://github.com/deftorch/devoxel-engine/blob/main/docs/Voxel%20-%20berbagai%20pendekatan.md): Survey of voxel data structure / meshing / rendering approaches this framework accommodates.
- [docs/gi-roadmap/](https://github.com/deftorch/devoxel-engine/blob/main/docs/gi-roadmap/): Phased global illumination implementation roadmap.
- [skill.md](https://github.com/deftorch/devoxel-engine/blob/main/skill.md): Engine capabilities and technical constraints.

## Engine Structure

- `/src/core`: The pluggable framework — `VoxelEngine`, `PluginRegistry`, base classes (`VoxelStorage`, `VoxelMesher`, `VoxelRenderer`), built-in plugins, WebGPU/WebGL renderers, bitECS components, math utilities.
- `/src/game`: The game runtime logic, including chunk generation workers and UI.
- `/src/editor`: The standalone voxel editor.
- `/src/data`: The data-driven JS registries (e.g., blocks, materials).
- `/src/test`: Tests (`node --test` style + browser-only WebGPU tests via `test_runner.html`).

## Entry Points

- Game Runtime: `/index.html`
- Standalone Editor: `/editor.html`
